name: Mary Wollstonecraft
shortBio: Pioneering Enlightenment moral and political philosopher whose seminal works asserted that women are rational beings entitled to equal education, moral autonomy, and fundamental human rights.
centralQuestion: How can an Enlightenment society claim to champion reason, liberty, and justice while systematically subordinating half of humanity through artificial educational deprivation?

keyWorks.title: A Vindication of the Rights of Woman
keyWorks.description: Landmark philosophical defense of gender equality, universal education, and female moral autonomy against Rousseau's educational domesticity.

keyWorks.title: A Vindication of the Rights of Men
keyWorks.description: Passionate Enlightenment rebuttal of Edmund Burke's conservative critique of the French Revolution, defending human equality and aristocracy critique.
